title: Services slice: Broadcast Relay, Conntrack Sync, Console Server, Salt Minion, Suricata
acceptance_criteria: Backend wrappers exist for broadcast-relay, conntrack-sync, console-server, salt-minion, and suricata.
System Services page exposes form-driven tabs for all five services without free-form CLI entry.
Services sidebar includes links for the five services in A-Z order.
Runtime smoke and browser smoke include all five tab routes and pass.
Coverage artifacts regenerate and show services domain progress (17 implemented, 6 partial).
assumptions: Advanced options for these services remain follow-up work (for example, Suricata EVE logging and some conntrack helper options).
Wrapper endpoints continue to use command-string batch payloads with strict subtree validation.
Unrelated dirty worktree files remain untouched.

tasks.notes: Extended service wrapper coverage and tests for five additional service domains.
Added five new service tabs and navigation entries.
Smoke coverage expanded for all new service tab routes.
Regenerated parity artifacts and confirmed services backlog reduction.
Manual reviewer pass complete; no API contract breakages introduced.
